annotations.title: Startup Funding Rounds Search: SEC Form D, Official Data

description: Find recent startup funding rounds from official SEC Form D filings (Regulation D private placements): company, state, industry group, offering amount, amount sold, first sale date, investor count and the filing link. Filter by date, industry, state and size; funds are excluded by default. Company-level only: no officers, directors or other persons are returned. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

includeAmendments.description: Also return Form D/A amendments (default: new filings only).

includeFunds.description: Also return pooled investment funds, REITs and similar vehicles (excluded by default).

industries.description: Keep filings whose Form D industry group contains one of these words (for example Technology, Biotechnology, Computers, Health). Default: all except funds.

limit.description: Maximum rounds returned. Each returned round is one billable result.

maxSeconds.description: Time budget for reading filings. A weekly scheduled run over many filings should use 300 or more; the result says whether every filing in range was read (complete) and gives nextSince for the next run.

minAmountUsd.description: Minimum total offering amount in USD.

since.description: First filing date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 7 days ago. Use the date of your last run for new rounds only.

states.description: Issuer state or country codes (for example CA, NY, TX).

until.description: Last filing date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today. At most 14 days after since.
